description: The Fond du Lac Band of Lake Superior Chippewa Combine Mitigation with Capacity Building is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Fond du Lac Band of Lake Superior Chippewa | Resource Management Division; Fond du Lac Band of Lake Superior Chippewa Reservation | Tribal Government; Minnesota Power. This Minnesota tribal community (which subscribes to the Seven Generations philosophy) is taking action to reduce its contributions to greenhouse gas emissions while simultaneously building community capacity to adapt. Coverage: Minnesota (2015). The toolkit gives Minnesota as the location, 2015 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
